get_rgb_depth: get the RGB and depth images from the Habitat simulator camera observations
get_intrinsics: get the 3x3 camera intrinsic matrix with focal length and principal point values
pix_to_3dpt: convert pixel row and column indices to 3D points with RGB colors in camera or base frame
set_pan_tilt: set the camera pan and tilt joint angles and update the sensor position and rotation
get_current_pcd: get the current point cloud with 3D coordinates and RGB colors from the depth and RGB images
